01 / THE HACKATHONGOOD IDEAS NEED GOOD COMPANY.

A different place.
A different perspective.
The same urge
to make things.

Doddabetta gives us our name. Ooty gives us the setting. The hackathon is about what happens when curious people get in a room and start building.

Bring your skills, your questions, and the idea you keep coming back to. Find collaborators. Try a new direction. Leave with something you can actually show.

<DEVELOPERS><DESIGNERS><THINKERS><FIRST-TIMERS>
[01]

Start with a problem.

Find something worth fixing. A thoughtful idea is a better starting point than a stack of features.

[02]

Build with your people.

Combine code, design, and a fresh perspective. Great teams make room for all three.

[03]

Make it demonstrable.

Show a working prototype, explain your choices, and tell us where it could go next.

    04 / BEFORE YOU BUILD

    Good questions.
    Clear answers.

    The event is taking shape. Confirmed dates, venue details, eligibility, and rules will be published with registration.

    Who is this for?+

    People who want to build: developers, designers, students, and curious problem-solvers. Final eligibility requirements will be announced with official registration.

    Do I need an existing team?+

    You can explore this preview as a solo builder or with a team. Team formation and confirmed team-size limits will be included in the event rules.

    Where and when is it happening?+

    Ooty is the intended location. The exact venue, date, and event duration are still to be announced.

    Can I register right now?+

    Official registration is not open yet. The preview lets you prepare and download a draft on this device; it does not submit an application or reserve a place.

    Are there prizes, mentors, or sponsors?+

    Those details have not been confirmed. We’ll list the real prizes, judging criteria, mentors, and partners when they are announced.

    What should I prepare?+

    A laptop, your usual development tools, and an open mind. Start with the build-brief tool to outline a problem and divide the first tasks. Final submission requirements will be shared with the event rules.
